listing.title: Should I apply? (listing day)
listing.question: Is it worth applying to sell on the first day of trading?
listing.label: Apply for listing-day gains
listing.reason: Financial health helped it most and price held it back. It scored 71 out of 100; the best verdict needs 65.
listing.confidence_note: 73% of the checks behind this view had the numbers they need.
listing.track_record: Past IPOs scoring 70 and up closed day one above the issue price 78% of the time (tested on 86 IPOs from 2024–25). Past IPOs with this verdict: closed day one above the issue price 77% of the time (typical +18%), tested on 101 IPOs from 2024–25.

holding.title: Business quality check
holding.question: How strong is the business behind the shares?
holding.label: Wait, and think about buying after it lists
holding.reason: Financial health helped it most and price held it back. It scored 68 out of 100; the best verdict needs 70.
holding.confidence_note: 61% of the checks behind this view had the numbers they need.
holding.track_record: A weak predictor of 1-year returns, about a coin flip: past IPOs with this verdict beat the Nifty 50 over 1 year 50% of the time (tested on 22 IPOs from 2024–25). Use it to understand the business, not to pick winners.
